runtimeMapping.Mizuki: Source direct ground-only unlimited MultiMeleeAttack hits every selected enemy. Original Attack(.533) for normal/S1, Skill_1(.533) for S2, Skill_2_Loop(.533) for S3, each capped to100ASPD. Native selectTargetTiming0 reacquires legal attack victims at CAST/release; conditional postFilter16 chooses the one/two/three lowest-current-HP selected targets, distinct from HP ratio; their separate AdvancedApplyDamage Arts rider uses selected talent coefficient and S1 talent_scale independent from physical atk_scale. S1 source recoverSpIfTargetDead restores a stored charge only when every original input dies before emission and no legal replacement is hit. S2 source attribute8/formula0 is additive BAT seconds; target buffs Bind/Stun on selected living victims do not require unshielded HP output. S3 expands to y-4, applies selected ATK and PURE MaxHP loss when fewer than3 targets are selected, bypassing mitigation/shields and able to kill. Native S3 Idle replacement and end mix are preserved without inventing an unwired Start phase.
runtimeMapping.Mizuki talent2: PurposeNONE/ignoreTargetFree1 range recipients own immediate-first .2-second LE-halfHP checkers. A single nonstack ATK percentage remains while any checker qualifies, updates on its native interval, drops membership immediately on departure and retains the original .02-second final modifier tail. Hidden pre-appearance/disappeared entities remain excluded; stealth/sleep/untargetable are included by the explicit ignoreTargetFree source flag.
limits: Native C# conditional-target postFilter16 and action-event enum order are not executable-recovered.
